name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order payload (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'YORB')
expected_outcome: Message routes to SalesOrder path, completes Test_Mapping, invokes Interface_Generic_Headers, and terminates successfully at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200.
validates: CallActivity_4 (Property & Header initialization), ExclusiveGateway_80 (Routing condition SalesOrder), CallActivity_102 (Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Generic Headers), EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Branch Route)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching SO Return criteria (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'POR')
expected_outcome: Message routes to SO Return branch, invokes CallActivity_71 (Interface_Generic_Headers), and terminates at EndEvent_9.

name: Routing Condition Not Met (Escalation End)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unmatched order type code (e.g., 'UNKNOWN_TYPE')
expected_outcome: Message takes default route SequenceFlow_110 to EndEvent_11, triggering Escalation with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'. SOAP Fault returned to caller.

name: Mapping Failure & Exception Subprocess Handling
trigger: Inbound SOAP payload with corrupt XML data causing runtime failure in Message Mapping 1
expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 intercepts error via StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 restores body from ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 attaches log, and EndEvent_95 terminates with Error status.
validates: SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 (Payload restoration), CallActivity_100 (Log_Payload.gsh), EndEvent_95 (Error End Event)

name: Malformed SOAP Envelope / CXF Inbound Validation
trigger: HTTP POST with invalid XML structure or unclosed SOAP Envelope tags
expected_outcome: Inbound CXF SOAP runtime raises CXF SOAP Fault without initiating process body execution.
validates: Inbound SOAP CXF adapter protocol compliance, XML well-formedness check
